title: Shut It Down
staging:
Scene 22 — Shut It Down

18:30–19:05 · 35 sec · Factory control room

The crew stops the automated distribution lines, preserves the refrigerated salmon, releases the shipment records publicly, and reroutes available trucks to the neglected districts.

Shots: Hacking screen → conveyor belts stopping → routing map changing → trucks redirected → public data release.
